legalTerminosTexto: 1. What it is Sajitarios Gamespot is a free app of party games to play as a group on a single phone. It works offline, with no accounts and no ads. 2. Using the app You may use it for your own and your group's entertainment. By using it you accept these terms. Use it respectfully: do not use it to harass, humiliate or hurt anyone. 3. Adult content Some content is for adults over 18 only and is marked as such: the "Banter" category in The Impostor, Taboo, Charades and Who am I?, and the spicy level of Never Have I Ever, Truth or Dare, Who's most likely…? and Would you rather?. The app asks for confirmation before turning it on. Only turn it on if everyone in the group is an adult and agrees. 4. Alcohol Some games, such as Never Have I Ever, Who's most likely…?, Would you rather? or Truth or Dare, can be played as drinking games. The app does not encourage drinking: if you drink, do so in moderation, never pressure anyone, do not drive afterwards and respect the legal drinking age in your country. You can play just as well without alcohol. 5. Your content The words, cards and categories you create, player names and history are stored only on your phone. You are responsible for what you write. 6. Intellectual property The app, its design and its texts belong to their authors. Trivia questions are based on Open Trivia DB (CC BY-SA 4.0) and the Roboto and Material Icons fonts are by Google (Apache 2.0). Names of people, brands, works and places in the word lists are used only as references for playing: they imply no relationship or sponsorship. Details are under "Licenses". 7. No warranty The app is provided as is. We do our best to make it work well, but it may contain errors, including in the questions and words. To the extent permitted by law, its authors are not liable for any damage caused by its use. 8. Changes These terms may change with new versions of the app. The current terms are always the ones shown here. Last updated: 26 October 2026.
legalPrivacidadTexto: Summary Sajitarios Gamespot does not collect, send or sell personal data. It has no accounts, no ads and no analytics, and it does not need an internet connection. What is stored on your phone To work, the app stores on the device itself: • The player names from the last game. • The words, cards and categories you create. • The Impostor game history and trivia wins. • Your preferences: language, sound, vibration and animations. None of this leaves your phone or reaches its authors. Permissions The app uses vibration for some alerts (when the bomb explodes or time runs out) and, in Who am I?, the motion sensor to tell when you tilt the phone; what it measures is not stored and never leaves the phone. Neither needs special permissions. Vibration can be turned off in Settings. Deleting your data History and your words can be deleted from within the app. To delete everything, clear the app's data in the system settings or uninstall it. Children The app collects no data from anyone, including children. Some content is for adults over 18 only and is marked as such. Changes If a future version changed how data is handled, this policy would be updated first. Last updated: 26 October 2026.
legalCookiesTexto: Does it use cookies? No. Sajitarios Gamespot is an app, not a website, and it uses no cookies or any similar technology to track you or show you ads. Storage on your phone The app stores your preferences (language, sound, vibration and animations) and your games on your phone so everything stays as you left it. This is technical storage needed for the app to work: it identifies no one, is shared with no one and never leaves the device. Third parties There are no third-party advertising, analytics or social media services. How to delete it Clear the app's data in the system settings or uninstall it. Last updated: 25 October 2026.

mimicaMenuDescripcion: In teams against the clock, without a single word.
mimicaEquiposAyuda: From 2 to 4. They play in turns in this order.
mimicaModoAyuda: In mix mode, each card says how to act it: mime, sounds only, drawing in the air or a single word.
mimicaPreparadoAyuda: Someone in the team takes the phone and acts without talking; the others guess. Change actor every turn.
reglasMimica1: You play in teams. Each turn, someone in the team takes the phone and sees a card.
reglasMimica2: They have to act it out without talking or pointing at things in the room, and their team has to guess it.
reglasMimica3: If they get it, "Got it" (+1) and another comes up. If it's too hard, "Pass" (depending on the rules, passes may be limited or cost a point).
reglasMimica4: When time runs out you review the cards and can fix anything noted wrong. Then the next team plays.
reglasMimica5: The first team to reach the chosen points at the end of a round wins; if it's a tie, another round is played.
reglasMimica6: In mix mode, each card says how to act it: mime, sounds only, drawing in the air or a single word. Banter is 18+.

quienSoyModoAyuda: In teams, one guesses and their team describes. Everyone for themselves, one guesses and all the others describe.
quienSoyEquiposAyuda: From 2 to 4. They play in turns in this order; change who holds the phone every turn.
quienSoyJugadoresAyuda: From 2 to 12. Each one puts the phone on their forehead in their turn.
quienSoyControlAyuda: With the phone on your forehead: tilt it down if you get it and up to pass. There are also buttons for the others.
quienSoyInclinarAyuda: If you turn it off, only the buttons count.
quienSoyInvertirAyuda: In case up and down are swapped on your phone.
quienSoyPreparadoAyuda: Whoever guesses puts the phone on their forehead, screen facing the others. The others describe the word without saying it.
quienSoyEmpezar: Start (3 s to put it on)
quienSoyPonteloEnLaFrente: Put the phone on your forehead
quienSoyComoBotones: The others tap Got it or Pass
reglasQuienSoy1: Whoever guesses puts the phone on their forehead, sideways and with the screen facing the others.
reglasQuienSoy2: The others (their team, or everyone if you play for yourselves) describe the word without saying or spelling it.
reglasQuienSoy3: If they get it, they tilt the phone down (+1); to pass, up. The side buttons can also be tapped.
reglasQuienSoy4: When time runs out you review the cards and fix anything noted wrong. Then it's the next one's turn.
reglasQuienSoy5: After the chosen rounds, whoever has the most correct wins; if it's a tie, another round is played.
reglasQuienSoy6: Choose the categories (Banter is 18+) and add your own cards from the bar: family, friends, your town…
loboMenuDescripcion: Secret roles and a game master who runs the night.
loboJugadoresAyuda: From 5 to 30, in the order you are sitting (it matters for the fox, the bear and the knight). The game master doesn't play.
loboRepartoAyuda: Pick a ready-made set or choose the cards yourself. You need one per player and, with the thief, two more.
loboReglaRevelarAyuda: When someone dies, their card is revealed.
loboReglaCapitanAyuda: On the first day a captain is elected: their vote counts double and, if they die, they name a successor.
loboReglaDesempateAyuda: Without a scapegoat, those tied are voted on again; if it's a tie again, nobody dies.
loboReglaLobosSeConocen: Wolves know each other when they see their card
loboReglaLobosSeConocenAyuda: When dealing, each wolf sees who the other wolves are.
loboReglaPrimeraNocheAyuda: On the first night the wolves meet but don't kill.
loboReglaProtectorRepiteAyuda: They can protect the same person two nights in a row.
loboReglaBrujaSeSalvaAyuda: She can use the life potion if she is the victim.
loboReglaIgualarAyuda: They win as soon as they are as many as the others (otherwise, when only they are left).
loboReglaAncianoAyuda: If the village kills the elder, the villagers lose their powers.
loboReglaLunaAyuda: Some mornings an event comes up that changes the rules for that day or the next night.
loboMasterAyuda: Cards are dealt by passing the phone; then the game master keeps the phone, doesn't play and runs the game.
loboErrorSinLobos: You need at least one wolf.
loboErrorGrupo: Sisters come in twos and brothers in threes.
loboErrorCopias: There are more cards of a role than the game allows.
loboErrorCartas: The cards don't add up: there are {n} and you need {total}.
loboPaqueteAyudaBasico: The roles of the classic game.
loboPaqueteAyudaAldea: More villagers with powers and tricks.
loboPaqueteAyudaLobos: Special wolves and those who may end up as one.
loboPaqueteAyudaSolitarios: They play alone, with their own goal.
loboRolDescAldeano: No powers: just their vote and their instinct to find the wolves.
loboRolDescLobo: Each night, with the other wolves, picks a victim. Wins if the wolves wipe out the village.
loboRolDescVidente: Each night points at someone and sees their card.
loboRolDescBruja: Has a life potion to save the wolves' victim and a death potion to kill anyone.
loboRolDescCazador: When they die, they shoot whoever they want and take them along.
loboRolDescCupido: On the first night picks two lovers: if one dies, the other dies of grief.
loboRolDescNina: Can peek with half-open eyes when the wolves wake up, without getting caught.
loboRolDescLadron: On the first night may swap their card for one of the two left over.
loboRolDescProtector: Each night protects someone from the wolves (not the same person two nights in a row).
loboRolDescAnciano: Survives the first wolf attack. If the village kills them, the villagers lose their powers.
loboRolDescChivoExpiatorio: If the vote is tied, they die.
loboRolDescTontoDelPueblo: If the village lynches them, they survive by revealing themselves, but can no longer vote.
loboRolDescHermana: The two sisters know each other from the first night.
loboRolDescHermano: The three brothers know each other from the first night.
loboRolDescZorro: Each night points at someone: learns whether they or a neighbour is a wolf. If none is, loses the scent.
loboRolDescCuervo: Each night may mark someone: the next day they get two extra votes against them.
loboRolDescOsoDomador: Each morning their bear growls if one of their living neighbours is a wolf.
loboRolDescCaballero: If the wolves kill them, the first wolf to their left dies the next night.
loboRolDescJuezTartamudo: Once per game can call a second vote on the same day.
loboRolDescSirvienta: Before the lynched player is revealed, can take their card and role.
loboRolDescPerroLobo: On the first night chooses whether they are with the village or with the wolves.
loboRolDescNinoSalvaje: On the first night picks a role model: if the model dies, they become a wolf.
loboRolDescLoboBlanco: Another wolf, but every other night may kill a wolf. Wins if left alone.
loboRolDescGranLoboMalo: As long as no wolf has died, kills one more victim each night.
loboRolDescPadreLobos: Once per game can infect the wolves' victim: they don't die and become a wolf.
loboRolDescAngel: Wins alone if they die on the first night or in the first vote. Otherwise, just a villager.
loboRolDescFlautista: Each night charms two players. Wins if everyone alive is charmed.
loboRolDescSectario: Players are split into two groups: wins if the whole other group dies.
reglasLobo1: The game master doesn't play: they deal the cards by passing the phone, like in The Impostor, and then run the game.
reglasLobo2: Each player sees their card in secret. The wolves want to wipe out the village; the village, to find and lynch the wolves; some play alone.
reglasLobo3: At night everyone closes their eyes. The game master calls each role in order: the app tells them who to call and what to note.
reglasLobo4: At dawn, the app announces who has died (and, depending on the rules, which card they had).
reglasLobo5: During the day you debate and vote: whoever gets the most votes is lynched. The captain's vote counts double and the raven adds two votes.
reglasLobo6: Some roles change the rules: the hunter shoots when dying, lovers die together, the idiot survives once…
reglasLobo7: The village wins if all wolves die; the wolves, if they wipe out the rest. The loners have their own goal.
reglasLobo8: The game master can undo, kill or revive by hand and see the log of the whole game.
loboQueNadieMire: Nobody else should look at the screen.
loboTuGrupo: Your group: {nombres}. You win if the whole other group dies.
loboLadronAviso: On the first night you may swap your card for one of the two left over.
loboAngelAviso: Get yourself killed on the first night or in the first vote.
loboDaleElMovil: Give the phone to the game master
loboDaleElMovilAyuda: Everyone has seen their card. From now on the game master, who doesn't play, keeps the phone.
loboTodosDuermen: Night falls: everyone closes their eyes. Call each role in this order.
loboEligeHastaN: {n, plural, one{Tap 1 (or nobody)} other{Tap up to {n} (or nobody)}}
loboExtraNina: Watch the little girl: she may peek with half-open eyes. If the wolves catch her, they may go for her.
loboExtraLunaLlena: Full moon: tonight the wolves pick two victims.
loboExtraSinVictima: Tonight the wolves only meet: there is no victim.
loboExtraLadron: The leftover cards are {carta1} and {carta2}. Show them to the thief.
loboZorroSiAyuda: They or one of their neighbours is a wolf. Nod to the fox.
loboZorroNoAyuda: Shake your head: the fox loses the scent and won't wake up again.
loboNarrarLadron: Thief, wake up. Look at these two cards: you may swap yours for one of them. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarCupido: Cupid, wake up and point at two people: they will fall in love. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarEnamorados: Lovers, wake up: I'll tap you on the shoulder. Look at each other. If one dies, the other dies of grief. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarPerroLobo: Wolfhound, wake up. Do you stay with the village or join the wolves? Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarNinoSalvaje: Wild child, wake up and point at your role model. If they die, you will become a wolf. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarHermanas: Sisters, wake up and recognise each other. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarHermanos: Brothers, wake up and recognise each other. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarProtector: Protector, wake up and point at who you protect tonight. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarVidente: Seer, wake up and point at someone: I'll show you their card. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarZorro: Fox, wake up and point at someone: I'll tell you if they or a neighbour is a wolf. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarLobos: Wolves, wake up. Recognise each other and agree in silence: point at your victim. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarPadreLobos: Wolf father, wake up. Do you infect the victim? They won't die and will become a wolf. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarGranLoboMalo: Big bad wolf, wake up again and point at a second victim. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarLoboBlanco: White werewolf, wake up. If you want, point at a wolf to kill them. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarBrujaSalva: Witch, wake up. This is tonight's victim: do you use your life potion to save them?
loboNarrarBrujaEnvenena: Do you use your death potion? Point at who, or nobody. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarFlautista: Piper, wake up and point at two people to charm them. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarEncantados: Charmed ones, wake up: I'll tap you on the shoulder. Recognise each other. Go back to sleep.
loboNarrarCuervo: Raven, wake up. If you want, point at someone: tomorrow they get two extra votes against them. Go back to sleep.
loboAyudaPasoLadron: Choose what the thief decides. If both cards are wolves, they must take one.
loboAyudaPasoCupido: Tap the two Cupid points at (they can choose themselves).
loboAyudaPasoEnamorados: Tap both lovers on the shoulder and press "Done".
loboAyudaPasoPerroLobo: Choose the side the wolfhound says.
loboAyudaPasoNinoSalvaje: Tap the player the wild child points at.
loboAyudaPasoHermanas: Let them recognise each other and press "Done".
loboAyudaPasoHermanos: Let them recognise each other and press "Done".
loboAyudaPasoProtector: Tap who they protect. Last night's choice isn't offered if the rule doesn't allow it.
loboAyudaPasoVidente: Tap who they point at: the app shows you their card so you can show it.
loboAyudaPasoZorro: Tap who they point at: the app tells you if there is a wolf among them and their neighbours.
loboAyudaPasoLobos: Tap the victim the wolves choose.
loboAyudaPasoPadreLobos: Choose what the wolf father decides. They can only infect once.
loboAyudaPasoLoboBlanco: Tap the wolf they want to kill (or nobody).
loboAyudaPasoBrujaSalva: Point out the victim and choose what she decides. She only has one life potion.
loboAyudaPasoBrujaEnvenena: Tap who she poisons, or "Nobody". She only has one death potion.
loboAyudaPasoEncantados: Tap all the charmed on the shoulder and press "Done".
loboMatarMensaje: Only use this if you made a mistake or someone leaves the game. It can be undone.
loboMuerteLobos: at the hands of the wolves
loboMuerteGranLobo: at the hands of the big bad wolf
loboMuerteLoboBlanco: at the hands of the white werewolf
loboEventoEnamorados: Cupid makes {jugador} and {otro} fall in love
loboEventoNinoSalvajeSeConvierte: {jugador} (wild child) loses their role model and becomes a wolf
loboEventoTontoSeSalva: {jugador} was the village idiot: survives but can no longer vote
loboEventoPoderesPerdidos: The village killed the elder: the villagers lose their powers
loboLunaDescLunaLlena: Tonight the wolves choose two victims.
loboLunaDescNocheEnCalma: Tonight the wolves don't kill anyone.
loboLunaDescEclipse: No debate today: go straight to the vote.
loboLunaDescNiebla: Today the cards of the dead stay secret.
loboLunaDescLunaRoja: Tonight the seer can't see anything.
loboLunaDescRebelion: Today the captain's vote counts like everyone else's.
loboLunaDescLunaDeSangre: Today, if the vote is tied, all the tied players die.
loboPendienteCazador: {nombre} was the hunter: before dying they shoot someone. Tap who.
loboPendienteSucesor: {nombre} was the captain: they name a successor. Tap who.
loboPendienteSirvienta: Before showing {nombre}'s card: does the servant ({sirvienta}) want to take it? If so, they reveal themselves as the servant and {nombre}'s card isn't shown.
loboTerminarMensaje: All the cards are shown. If nobody has won yet, the game ends without a winner.
loboNarrarAmanecer: Dawn breaks over the village! Everyone opens their eyes.
loboHanMuerto: {n, plural, one{{nombres} died tonight.} other{{nombres} died tonight.}}
loboOsoGrune: The bear growls: grrr! There's a werewolf next to the tamer.
loboCapitanAyuda: The village elects a captain: their vote counts double and, if they die, they name a successor. Tap the chosen one.
loboDebateAyuda: The village discusses who might be a werewolf. Start the clock when they start talking.
loboVotacionAyuda: On three, everyone points at who they want to lynch. Count the votes with the plus and minus buttons.
loboSegundaVotacionAyuda: It was a tie: vote again, only between {nombres}.
loboVotacionesQuedan: {n, plural, one{1 vote left today} other{{n} votes left today}}
loboVotoCapitanDoble: {nombre}'s vote (captain) counts double: add it twice.
loboJuezAyuda: If the judge ({nombre}) gave you their signal, there's another vote today (only once per game).
reglasLobo9: With moon events, some mornings something happens that changes the rules for that day or the next night (full moon, eclipse, storm…). The app tells the game master.
